title: C-glycosylated and alkylated flavonoids with potent anti-inflammatory activity from the whole plants of Drymaria cordata.
authors: Lu, Lan-Yi; Wu, Yan-Hua; Zhang, Peng; Wang, Li-Yan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物中黄酮类化合物的抗炎活性及NF-κB通路抑制机制，分子对接仅针对IKK蛋白，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Drymaria cordata is a traditional Chinese medicinal plant used for the treatment of hepatitis and chronic nephritis. Six previously undescribed flavonoid C-glycosides (1-3, 8, 9, 11), two unreported alkylated flavonoids (4, 5), and four known flavonoids (6, 7, 10, 12) were isolated from its 70 % ethanol extract. The structures were established by extensive analysis of NMR, HRMS, and X-ray single-crystal diffraction. All compounds exhibited inhibitory activity against nitric oxide production, with compound 8, which contains a rare sugar moiety (3,5-dihydroxy-6-methyl-gamma-pyrone), showing the most pronounced effect. Further investigation revealed that 8 suppressed the expression of several key cytokines and inhibited the phosphorylation of p65. Molecular docking studies indicated that 8 targeted IKK, an upstream regulator of the NF-kappaB pathway, thereby blocking its activation.
abstract_zh: Drymaria cordata是一种传统中药材，用于治疗肝炎和慢性肾炎。从其70%乙醇提取物中分离得到六个此前未描述的黄酮C-糖苷类化合物（1-3, 8, 9, 11）、两个未报道的烷基化黄酮类化合物（4, 5）以及四个已知黄酮类化合物（6, 7, 10, 12）。通过NMR、HRMS和X射线单晶衍射的广泛分析确定了其结构。所有化合物均表现出对一氧化氮产生的抑制活性，其中含有稀有糖部分（3,5-二羟基-6-甲基-γ-吡喃酮）的化合物8显示出最显著的效果。进一步研究表明，8抑制了多种关键细胞因子的表达，并抑制了p65的磷酸化。分子对接研究显示，8靶向IKK（NF-kappaB通路的上游调节因子），从而阻断其激活。
